notes.note: Reviewed profile and host-wide busy responses against the manager's admission checks and the existing device-code POST route. Every active or unresolved-stop process reserves capacity, and a full host refuses another profile with 429.

Reviewed the unconfirmed-stop recovery guidance against process tree termination and the startup ownership sweep. The host operator verifies the launcher and its descendants before restarting Station. A host restart is the fallback when the operator cannot confirm tree exit.
Reviewed the device-code host-slot clarification and checked its Terminal and integration references. The added capacity behavior applies to the existing profile sign-in leaf.

Reviewed the current and unresolved-stop slot accounting against the Connections and Agent guides. A cancelled or expired login reserves capacity until owned tree exit is confirmed. The existing profile enrollment and authorization checks still govern startup.
